'''Stitchy''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Prior to the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Stitchy served as court physician for [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]]. Losing his job during the Imperial occupation, Stitchy went on to become the medic for champion [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxer]] [[Lobar Aybock]].

==Behind the scenes==
Stitchy was created by [[What's The Story?]] author [[Edward M. Erdelac]] for his official ''[[Star Wars]]'' authorial debut in the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive short story ''[[Fists of Ion]]''. According to Erdelac, Stitchy's name came from [[Wikipedia:Cutman|cutman]] Jacob "Stitch" Duran of the [[Wikipedia:Ultimate Fighting Championship|Ultimate Fighting Championship]].

Apailana was confirmed as Stitchy's former employer in Ed Erdelac's blog on [[StarWars.com]], after being referred to as "Apa-something" in "Fists of Ion."
